reason: The README describes a plugin primarily for code and AI-response review, including multi-model evaluation, review history, and follow-up questions based on quoted responses.

summaries.zh: 用于对代码和 AI 回复进行多模型交叉评审，并支持引用问答与评审记录回看。
summaries.en: A plugin for cross-model review of code and AI responses with quote-based follow-up questions and review history.

capabilities: Reviews code and AI responses using defined quality criteria
Submits content to multiple models for independent review and aggregation
Generates quote-based follow-up questions from selected AI responses
Persists review history and model preferences through host storage
Applies request rate, concurrency, body-size, and origin restrictions
